reason: Langfuse builds an open-source (MIT) LLM engineering platform: hierarchical tracing of LLM calls, tool invocations and retrieval steps, evaluations (LLM-as-a-judge, human annotation), prompt management and a playground. Its users are teams building LLM/RAG applications, so the ai variant fits best; observability wording and the fullstack TypeScript/Next.js side are surfaced because the careers page lists Backend, Frontend and Integrations engineers and the product is an observability tool.
flags: Langfuse stores traces in ClickHouse and transactional data in PostgreSQL; neither is in facts.yaml, CV highlights MongoDB/MySQL/Redis instead
